title: Stocking a shelf slot by slot
target: How to stock a shelf in Supermarket Simulator when the game treats it as separate slots rather than as one open surface you can pile goods onto.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shelf already placed in the shop
Stock in the storage room or in a box nearby
A product that suits the shelf you are filling

steps.do: Treat each shelf as a set of positions and fill them one at a time.
steps.because: a shelf is kept as a set of rack slots with their own records (RackSlot)

steps.do: Fill the gaps rather than restocking from the left every time.
steps.because: each slot carries an index of its own, so the game knows which ones are empty (rackSlotIndex)

steps.do: Move boxes off the shelf once you have emptied them.
steps.because: a box standing on a shelf is tracked against a slot as well (RackSlotBoxTarget)

steps.do: Use a display case for what belongs in it instead of treating it as another shelf.
steps.because: display slots are tracked apart from rack slots (DisplaySlot)

steps.do: Do not force a product into a display that is built for something else.
steps.because: a display slot can carry a condition on what may be placed in it (IDisplaySlotProductPlacementCondition)

commonMistakes: Restocking only the front of a shelf and leaving gaps behind it.
Leaving empty boxes on the shelf after filling it.
Piling goods onto a display case that wants a particular product.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
